thread:
PagerDuty Bot: INCIDENT PAGE - high-severity - gpu_capacity_exhaustion in eu-south3. Autoscaler failing to allocate new GPU nodes, queue growth observed. Trigger: queue_size > 3k for 5m. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
Sam B: seeing large queue on infer-queue-eu-south3, pods stuck Pending with reason=PodFitsResources/InsufficientGPUs
Lee K: confirmed. Kube events show failed scaleup: "Failed to create instance: quotaExceeded" from cloud-provider.
Maria C: customer impact? any 500s or latency spikes surfaced?
Sam B: yes — higher latency and 429s for burst-tier customers. Self-serve hosted API rates spiking for a handful of clients.
Customer Success (Aisha): I have 2 customers on support threads complaining about degraded throughput, one is actively throttling on our side. They asked for ETA.
Sam B: actions: 1) try warm-pool fallback (warmpool nodes in eu-west1), 2) reroute best-effort non-SLA traffic to eu-west1, 3) open quota escalation with GCP.
Infra Bot: warmpool check: warm-pool-eu-west1 has 120 GPUs available, warm-pool-eu-south3 has 0.
Lee K: initiating ephemeral routing rule: update route table to prefer eu-west1 for non-SLA models. Pushing config now.
Sam B: push command: ```bash
# reroute non-sla traffic
redwoodctl routes update --from-region=eu-south3 --to-region=eu-west1 --filter="tier!=enterprise" --priority=low
```
Maria C: applying temporary rate limit for burst customers in eu-south3 to reduce queue growth: `rlimit set api.burst 50rps --region eu-south3`
Oncall Shift Lead (Jorge): Sam, open a Cloud quota case and mark as P1. Provide project ID and a request for temporary quota bump + justification (production outage).
Sam B: opened GCP support case #CASE-2026-1256, marked P1. ETA from GCP initial triage: 45m. Included logs: `quotaExceeded` errors and allocation attempts.
Infra Bot: observed autoscaler retries 75 attempts in last 10m, max_retries reached, fallback disabled by policy.
Lee K: enabling warmpool fallback in autoscaler config: setting `allow_warmpool_fallback=true` on scaling group for eu-south3. Patching now.
Infra Bot: warmpool fallback patch applied, starting relocation: 200 pending pods will be bound to warmpool instances in eu-west1.
Sam B: note—we're keeping enterprise traffic pinned to eu-south3 to respect data residency. Non-SLA traffic will shift.
Customer Success (Aisha): informing customers: "We're routing non-critical requests to eu-west1 and applying temporary limits in eu-south3 while we resolve a capacity issue with the cloud provider. No action required on your side."
Maria C: monitoring dashboard shows queue size dropping from 3200 -> 1800 after reroute, latency 95p improving.
Lee K: still seeing some Pending pods due to node taints mismatch; applying taint toleration patch to warmpool instances: ```yaml
# add tolerations to warmpool node pool
kubectl patch nodepool warmpool-eu-west1 --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"gpu-type","operator":"Equal","value":"v100","effect":"NoSchedule"}]}}}}'
```
Sam B: action item for next hour: - follow up with GCP for quota bump, - keep reroute active, - observe customer impact and reopen if enterprise customers affected.
Cloud Support (GCP): we've escalated internally. Can you provide the exact quota metric (GPUs per region per project) and a short spike timeline? We see an automated surge from a workload originating in eu-south3.
Sam B: case comment added with `project: redwood-prod-001, metric: GPUs_PER_REGION_eu-south3, spike_start: 2026-03-15T09:12Z, current_queue: ~1800`
Infra Bot: automated mitigation applied: `scale_down_delay=0` disabled to allow faster turnover, and KV cache warmup for hot prefixes in eu-west1 triggered.
Maria C: customer impact note for postmortem: multiple non-SLA customers experienced increased tail latency and 429s for 20-40 minutes. Enterprise customers unaffected so far.
Oncall Shift Lead (Jorge): handoff at 09:45Z -> handover notes: warmpool fallback active, GCP case open P1, reroute active for non-SLA, enterprise pinned, alerts silenced except critical. Next oncall please monitor queue and confirm quota resolution with GCP.
Sam B: assigning postmortem owner: @Maria C. Root-cause hypothesis: regional quota hit combined with aggressive autoscaler retry/backoff resulted in scale-up stall. Follow-ups: request auto-quota-bump playbook, add capacity buffer/safety for high-traffic windows, improve autoscaler fallback tests.
Customer Success (Aisha): sending customer updates now.
Cloud Support (GCP): case updated — provisional quota increase granted for 2 hours while we investigate. Please confirm if you want permanent increase.
Sam B: accepted provisional increase, monitoring. Queue now down to 400 and latency back to normal for most customers. Closing page for on-call; will escalate to infra team for follow-up work. :white_check_mark:
Maria C: noted for postmortem: timeline, mitigations (warmpool fallback, reroute, rate-limits), and action items (playbook, testing warmpool path, add buffer).
Oncall Shift Lead (Jorge): thanks team. I'll add follow-up ticket and assign infra eng to review autoscaler backoff and quota handling during next sprint.
